title: Payper
tagline: PayPer is meant to be a pay per view newspaper for independent journalists.
description: The project is a newspaper where instead of having to pay a high subscription price to get access to everything you can carefully select which articles interests you and pay those to read them, in the future we want to add more types of payments, such as being able to subscribe to a category, to a journalists maybe or an edition built by a curator/DAO so you only pay for exactly the types of content you want to see/listen/consume.
how_its_made: The project uses contracts to store the articles, journalist and everything part of the protocol. We query most of the information by building a subgraph using The Graph. We added social login with Web3Auth and Safe Account with Safe Protocol, we use wagmi for the frontend. We're building notifications for whenever a journalist gets a payment, or when a journalist posts a new article.
